How to Find Best Value With Tech ETFs April 06, 2018, 12:48:23 PM EDT By editor@etftrends.com (ETF Trends), Tom Lydon Shutterstock photo 
FAANG stocks, or Facebook (NasdaqGS: FB), Apple (NadaqGS: AAPL), Amazon (NasdaqGS: AMZN), Netflix (NasdaqGS: NFLX) and Google (NasdaqGS: GOOG), are not often considered value plays. The same goes for the broader technology sector. Technology's bullish ways are not, however, a free lunch as rising valuations indicate.
